verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a first-party natural-language command interface for operating Workable, such as a chat or prompt-driven console. The official MCP server gives external AI agents programmatic access, but that belongs to the MCP-server story and does not transfer here. The Workable Agent is described as running sourcing and screening autonomously, and the AI candidate search is vague, so neither shows users issuing natural-language commands to operate the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
